description.value:
Ability Scores: DEX, WIS, CHA

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.suns-of-rubi-core.feats.FeatLuckyOrigin1]{Lucky}

Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2 from DEC, INS, ITM, SLT

Feature: Let's Make It Interesting

You can always find high-stakes or backroom games of chance in any settlement or orbital station. Whether dice, holographic poker, or sabacc, your reputation as a gambler earns you an invitation to VIP lounges, smuggler dens, and corporate executive card tables. In addition, when negotiating terms, you can propose a wager or game of skill/chance to resolve impasses, establish mutual respect, or win critical favors from high-ranking adversaries.

Roleplay Characteristics

Personality Traits

d6 Trait
1I calculate odds and risk percentages out loud in high-stress situations.
2I always flip a credstick or roll a lucky die when faced with a tough choice.
3I smile widest when the stakes are lethal and the odds are stacked against me.
4I never leave a table while I am ahead; momentum is a force of nature.
5I can read micro-tells, dilated pupils, and vocal tremors with terrifying accuracy.
6Win or lose, I take pleasure in the game itself.

Ideals

d6 Trait
1Luck. The cosmos is governed by random chance, and those who dare to play win the galaxy. (Chaotic)
2Fairness. Cheating ruins the thrill of true victory; the game must be played by the rules. (Lawful)
3Independence. With a steady hand and a deck of cards, I need no master or corporation. (Neutral)
4Generosity. When the luck rolls my way, everyone at my table eats and drinks like royalty. (Good)
5Exploitation. A sucker is born every second, and it is my duty to separate them from their credits. (Evil)
6Audacity. Safe choices lead to slow deaths; fortune truly favors the audacious. (Any)

Bonds

d6 Trait
1I once won a customized starship in a legendary high-stakes tournament; I'll die before losing it.
2I owe an astronomical credit debt to an interplanetary crime syndicate that wants my head.
3My lucky coin was passed down through five generations of frontier spacers.
4A fellow card shark betrayed me on a joint heist; I aim to settle the score at the table.
5Everything I gamble for is dedicated to funding an independent haven for runaways.
6I swore an oath to clean out the corporate casino that bankrupt my parents.

Flaws

d6 Trait
1I simply cannot walk away from a wager or bet, no matter the terrible consequences.
2I constantly overestimate my ability to bluff my way out of mortal danger.
3I am addicted to the adrenaline rush of risking everything on a single roll.
4I have a habit of borrowing funds from companions with grand promises of returns.
5I become irrationally angry when someone accuses me of cheating without proof.
6I trust my gut and superstition over sound military logistics.

advancement.title: Ability Score Improvement
advancement.hint: Your background allows you to increase your DEX, WIS, CHA scores: increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

advancement.title: Skill Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Choose 2 skills from: dec, ins, itm, slt.

advancement.title: Tool Proficiencies
advancement.hint: Your background grants you tool proficiency options.

advancement.title: Origin Feat
advancement.hint: Your background grants you the Lucky origin feat.
